logline: A small-town man trapped between the woman he loves and the powerful politician's daughter obsessed with him navigates blackmail, murder, and moral compromise in darkly comic pulp thriller style.

bollymeter.basis: Rotten Tomatoes critic score of 40 percent from 5 reviews reflects the split between its pulpy entertainment value and thin character work; audience score of 72 percent and IMDb rating of 7.0 indicate stronger viewer goodwill than critical.

pull_quotes.text: A tasty story that manages to stretch the imagination - a little childish in delivery but worth watching.

seasons.review_body: Director Sidharth Sengupta (Apharan) launched the series on Netflix on January 14, 2022. Season 1 runs eight episodes and follows Vikrant Singh Chauhan, a middle-class man forced into proximity with an obsessive politician's daughter while trying to protect his real relationship. High on Films concluded it was too repetitive to be good despite its trashy entertainment intentions; Ready Steady Cut called it a tasty story that stretches the imagination despite childish delivery. The 40 percent Rotten Tomatoes score (5 critics) suggests a limited and mixed critical take, while the 72 percent audience score and 7.0 IMDb rating indicate the show found its target viewer effectively.

episode_reviews.title: Do You Love Me?
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The premiere establishes the genre register immediately - part romantic comedy, part anxiety nightmare. Vikrant's situation is designed to test audience tolerance for escalating absurdity; Sengupta leans into that tension rather than softening it.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The first public display of Purva's obsession - a scene that signals the show will not play its premise for sympathy.

episode_reviews.title: Maar Hi Daaloge
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The finale closes the first arc but leaves enough unresolved to justify a second season.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The sequence that resets the power dynamic between Vikrant and Purva, upending the dynamic built across eight episodes.

bollymeter.basis: Critical consensus called Season 2 a complete letdown - plot holes, weak characterisation, and a B-grade thriller register that abandoned the pulpy momentum the original built.

seasons.review_body: Released November 22, 2024, Season 2 ran six episodes and drew predominantly negative reviews. DM Talkies, whose review was amplified by IMDb's news section, called it a complete letdown, citing plot holes, weak character motivation, and a failure to build on Season 1's sleazy momentum. The season was described as delivering a B-grade thriller drama without the self-aware irony that made the first season passable. The season attempted to escalate its stakes while losing grip on the tone that had given the original its identity.
